name: FinalShell
product: FinalShell SSH and server management client by HostBuf

evidence.says: HostBuf dates FinalShell 4.6.3 to May 21, 2025 and offers separate ARM64 and Intel macOS installers.

name: Trader Workstation Installer
product: Interactive Brokers Trader Workstation installer (install4j)

evidence.says: The scan identifies the bundle as Trader Workstation Installer and records install4j metadata in its Info.plist.
Interactive Brokers provides distinct Apple Silicon and Intel downloads for the actual Trader Workstation product.

notes: The submitted app is the installation wrapper for Trader Workstation.

name: AX8-Edit
product: AX8-Edit preset editor and librarian by Fractal Audio Systems

evidence.says: Fractal Audio lists the Mac download of AX8-Edit 1.10.1, released July 21, 2026, as Universal.

notes: Requires AX8 hardware running firmware version 6.00 or later.

name: PostWebATMService
product: HiTrust PostWebATMService smart-card reader helper for Chunghwa Post WebATM

evidence.says: Chunghwa Post identifies PostWebATMService as the resident macOS component that connects a chip-card reader to its browser-based WebATM site.

limitation: The current helper version and architecture were not verified.
notes: Classify as a browser service component.

name: DbVisualizer
product: DbVisualizer by DbVis Software

evidence.says: The vendor offers a dedicated macOS Apple Silicon DMG for DbVisualizer 26.3 alongside a separate Intel DMG.
The vendor dates DbVisualizer 26.3 to 2026-11-19.

name: Mailspring
product: Mailspring by Foundry 376

evidence.says: The project marks 1.26.2 as its latest stable release and dates it to 2026-10-22.
The official assets for 1.26.2 include Mailspring-AppleSilicon.zip.

notes: Mailspring 2.0 was available as a release candidate at the audit date.

name: WindTerm
product: WindTerm by KingToolbox

evidence.says: The official 2.7.0 release lists one Mac asset, WindTerm_2.7.0_Mac_Portable_x86_64.dmg, dated March 11, 2025.
Users of the current Mac release report running WindTerm via Rosetta on Apple Silicon and request an ARM64 build.

name: Flameshot
product: Flameshot by the Flameshot project

evidence.says: The project marks v15.0.0 as its latest release.
The versioned asset list contains separate macOS arm64 and Intel disk images published on 2026-11-07.

name: AVG Cleaner
product: AVG Cleaner for Mac by AVG Technologies

evidence.says: AVG confirms that Cleaner no longer receives updates, identifies Mac build 4766 and recommends AVG TuneUp Premium.
The Mac App Store dates the final listed version, 14.0.4766, to September 28, 2016.
The scan for the exact com.avg.Cleaner bundle reports only x86 architecture for build 4766.

limitation: The final build is Intel-only per the scan, and Rosetta runtime compatibility was not verified.
notes: The legacy Mac App Store listing remains accessible.

name: Firefoo
product: Firefoo desktop client for Firebase Firestore by MLTEK

evidence.says: Firefoo’s distribution site lists dedicated macOS ARM64 DMG and Darwin ARM64 builds for the current release, 1.5.11.
The vendor dates 1.5.11 to January 25, 2023 and records that Apple Silicon support was introduced in 1.4.1.

name: Reason
product: Reason digital audio workstation by Reason Studios (formerly Propellerhead Software)

evidence.says: Reason Studios states that Reason 12.6 and later run natively on Apple Silicon.
Reason Studios lists 14.1.0 as its newest Reason release.
Reason Studios offers the 14.1.0 full macOS installer.

name: TestNav
product: TestNav desktop assessment app by Pearson

evidence.says: Pearson’s live installer manifest identifies testnav-1.15.7-arm64.dmg and testnav-1.15.7-x64.dmg as the current Mac downloads.
Pearson directs Apple Silicon Mac users to install the ARM TestNav app.

limitation: Pearson’s installer manifest does not date the 1.15.7 desktop build.

name: Capture NX-D
product: Capture NX-D RAW photo processing software by Nikon

evidence.says: Nikon ended Capture NX-D installer distribution on 2022-06-30 and directs users to NX Studio.
Nikon identifies 1.6.5 as the final macOS version.
Nikon announced availability of Capture NX-D 1.6.5 on 2021-03-02.
Nikon verified basic operation of Capture NX-D 1.6.5 on Apple Silicon under Rosetta 2 on macOS Big Sur.

notes: Final Mac build was Intel and used Rosetta 2 on Apple Silicon. NX Studio succeeded it.

name: Electron Keyan
product: 棵岩阅读 (Keyan Reading) research-paper reader and reference manager by Shanghai Soulcode Technology (上海守扣科技)

evidence.says: The publisher’s site identifies 棵岩阅读 as its research reader and links its macOS download.
A GET to the linked macOS download redirected to the publisher’s file 棵岩阅读-0.6.2-universal.dmg, which returned the requested byte.

limitation: The publisher's universal artifact was identified by filename and the main executable was not inspected.
notes: Electron Keyan is the scanner alias for 棵岩阅读.

name: Duplicate Annihilator for Photos
product: Duplicate Annihilator for Photos by Brattoo Propaganda Software

evidence.says: Brattoo offers the Photos edition of Duplicate Annihilator from its product page.
Homebrew links Brattoo’s ZIP, identifies version 9.1.0 build 1, and lists the exact bundle ID in app paths.

notes: Inspected the official Duplicate Annihilator for Photos.zip version 9.1.0 build 1: Contents/MacOS/Duplicate Annihilator for Photos contains arm64 and x86_64 slices.

name: CradleHub
product: Cradle Hub by Cradle

evidence.says: Cradle offers the current macOS Cradle Hub installer and lists Apple Silicon M1 or better among its system requirements.
Cradle confirms that Cradle Hub itself has run natively on Apple Silicon since its fall 2022 updates.

notes: Inspected CradleHub-v1.6.0.0-Setup.pkg, whose app Info.plist identifies app.cradle.CradleHub version 1.6.0 and whose Contents/MacOS/Cradle Hub executable contains arm64 and x86_64 slices.

name: Camera Settings
product: Logitech Camera Settings

evidence.says: Logitech lists and hosts Mac release 3.0.23, last updated October 26, 2020.
A user reports that Logitech Camera Settings was running on an M1 MacBook Pro, with unusually high memory usage in their session.

limitation: The M1 report establishes that the process runs, with no verification of every camera control on current macOS.
notes: Inspected the official LogiCameraSettings_3.0.23.pkg: Camera Settings.app identifies com.logitech.vc.CameraSettings and its Contents/MacOS/LogitechCamera executable is x86_64 only.

name: Olive
product: Olive Video Editor by the Olive project

evidence.says: Olive’s download page directs users to the project’s older official downloads on GitHub.
Olive identifies 0.2.0-nightly as an unstable development build.
The official release assets include the Mac build Olive-ea47e4d8-macOS-arm64.dmg, dated December 5, 2024.

limitation: The latest official Apple Silicon download is an unstable development build.
notes: The official Olive-1e3cf53-macOS.zip from release 0.1.0 contains Olive.app with the scanned com.yourcompany.Olive bundle ID.

name: Cyberex SecAccess
product: 研发云零信任 (R&D Cloud Zero Trust), vendor unconfirmed

evidence.says: The scan preserves the Chinese app name 研发云零信任, bundle ID com.cyberex.SecAccess, and historical version 1.0.0.

limitation: No vendor attribution, current official macOS download, or architecture evidence could be verified.
notes: The Homebrew name matches point to unrelated cloud storage and payment utilities.

name: Anvil
product: Anvil for Mac, the Pow local-site menu bar app by Beach Ltd.

evidence.says: Beach’s Anvil repository identifies the official domain, describes development as inactive and lists no binary releases.
GitHub records the last push to Beach’s official Anvil repository on January 19, 2017.
MacUpdate’s surviving listing identifies version 1.1.8, dated January 5, 2018, as Intel 64-bit.
The exact com.riot.Anvil 1.1.8 scan names Beach in its bundle metadata and records a 64-bit Intel executable.

limitation: No formal end-of-life notice or Rosetta runtime test was found.
notes: The original project site did not load and the old Sparkle update endpoint returned HTTP 404.

name: Photo Exifer
product: Photo Exifer by Fireebok

evidence.says: Fireebok’s Photo Exifer page links to the official photoexifer.dmg macOS download.

notes: Inspected the official photoexifer.dmg: Photo Exifer.app identifies com.fireebok.photoexifer version 3.9.60, and Contents/MacOS/Photo Exifer contains arm64 and x86_64 slices.

name: Quicksilver
product: Quicksilver, originally by Blacktree and maintained by the Quicksilver project

evidence.says: The project publishes Quicksilver 2.6.0 as a macOS release dated April 19, 2026.
The project’s official site offers Quicksilver for macOS and links to its GitHub release history.

notes: Inspected the official Quicksilver.2.6.0.dmg: Quicksilver.app identifies com.blacktree.Quicksilver version 2.6.0 build 4054, and Contents/MacOS/Quicksilver contains arm64 and x86_64 slices.

name: SGSkinEditor
product: Sogou Skin Editor for Mac by Sogou

evidence.says: Sogou’s editor page offers the Mac download and dates its editor release, labeled 1.0.0 on the page, to February 28, 2019.
Static inspection of SGSkinEditor.app/Contents/MacOS/SGSkinEditor inside sogou_mac_skinEditor_10b.dmg found x86_64 only and its plist identifies version 1.0 and bundle com.sogou.SGSkinEditor.

limitation: No credible evidence established whether the editor runs under Rosetta 2.
notes: This standalone editor creates skins for the Sogou input method.

name: Syncplay
product: Syncplay by the Syncplay project

evidence.says: The project dates 1.7.6 to 2026-08-04 and provides a Mac disk image for macOS 15 or later.
Inspection of Syncplay.app/Contents/MacOS/Syncplay from Syncplay_1.7.6.dmg found x86_64 and arm64 slices, with the matching bundle ID and version 1.7.6 in its Info.plist.

name: GK6+
product: GK6+ Mac App keyboard configuration utility by Jikedingzhi / SKYLOONG

evidence.says: SKYLOONG lists GK6+ Mac App 1.0.0.27, dated 2024-11-05, for Intel macOS.

limitation: Rosetta 2 operation, including keyboard detection, was not verified for 1.0.0.27.
notes: The same vendor page lists several different keyboard configuration products.

name: Dremel DigiLab 3D Slicer
product: Dremel DigiLab 3D Slicer 1.x by Dremel / 3PI Tech Solutions

evidence.says: The licensee distributes the Cura-based 1.x application separately from its Orca-based Desktop Slicer 2.0.
Inspection of Dremel DigiLab 3D Slicer.app/Contents/MacOS/Dremel DigiLab 3D Slicer in the official ZIP found only x86_64, and Info.plist identifies com.eht3.slicer and build 1.2.3.
Homebrew lists the same 1.2.3 package as Intel and says it requires Rosetta 2 on Apple Silicon.

limitation: No vendor release date was found for 1.2.3.
notes: The bundled short version is 1.2. The vendor labels the separately distributed native Orca-based successor Desktop Slicer 2.0.

name: HwpMac2014VIEWER
product: Hancom Office HWP Viewer for Mac (한컴오피스 한글 Viewer) by HANCOM Incorporated

evidence.says: Apple’s lookup identifies the current 12.31.9 release, dated October 19, 2026, as the exact com.haansoft.HancomOfficeViewer.Mac bundle.
The version history links the legacy 2014 VP viewer to the current app but does not identify the 12.31.9 binary architecture.
CoreCode reports Intel and Apple Silicon slices for an earlier release of the exact bundle, 12.31.4.

limitation: Universal architecture is documented for 12.31.4 only and could not be verified for the current 12.31.9 release.
notes: The legacy bundle is still distributed under the Hancom Office HWP Viewer name.

name: Algodoo
product: Algodoo 2D physics simulation sandbox by Algoryx Simulation AB

evidence.says: Algoryx promotes its current desktop download as updated for Apple Silicon.
The vendor download page links to the standalone macOS disk image named for version 2.2.4.
CoreCode records Intel and Apple Silicon executable architecture for the exact se.algoryx.algodoo-regular bundle at version 2.2.4, dated 2025-07-10.

limitation: The architecture slices are reported by CoreCode, and the official disk image exceeds the 150 MB inspection limit.

name: Cabbage
product: Cabbage standalone Csound IDE by Rory Walsh and Cabbage Audio

evidence.says: The project labels 2.10.0 its end-of-life release of Cabbage 2 and dates it January 9, 2025.
The tagged release’s macOS build script explicitly configures arm64 and x86_64 when building Cabbage.
Cabbage Audio says that Cabbage 3 removes the standalone IDE and moves editing into a Visual Studio Code extension.

limitation: The final installer executable was not inspected separately.
notes: The final standalone version's build configuration targets Apple Silicon and Intel.

name: Pixie
product: Pixie 4 desktop creativity software by Tech4Learning

evidence.says: Tech4Learning directs Pixie users to the online Wixie product and offers a migration discount.
Tech4Learning retains the legacy Pixie 4 Mac installer and lists 4.06, dated 2017-12-14, as the downloadable version.
The vendor’s Pixie release notes end with 4.06.

limitation: The architecture of the final Pixie 4 installer was not established.
notes: The vendor still hosts the version 4.06 legacy installer after moving the product online as Wixie.

name: Momentum
product: Momentum Usenet newsreader by HolmeZ SoftSolutions

evidence.says: HolmeZ’s former product website displays a farewell notice.
A review of the HolmeZ Usenet client records that downloads, updates and support ended after the vendor shutdown.

limitation: The final official Mac release number and architecture could not be verified.
notes: This bundle belongs to the USENET client.

name: CLIP STUDIO
product: Clip Studio launcher and works/material manager by CELSYS

evidence.says: CELSYS describes the separately launched macOS Clip Studio component and its app-launching, works, materials, and cloud features.
CELSYS documents native M1 support for the separate Clip Studio Paint editor in its 1.10.3 release notes.

limitation: No versioned architecture evidence was found for the jp.co.celsys.CLIPSTUDIO launcher executable.
notes: The launcher ships with Clip Studio Paint, whose current macOS package is larger than the brief’s binary-inspection limit.

name: FMOD Studio
product: FMOD Studio desktop audio authoring tool by Firelight Technologies (FMOD)

evidence.says: FMOD’s official download page requires sign-in to view the current installers.
A macOS crash report shows the exact org.fmod.fmodstudio executable running as native ARM-64 in March 2025, but records only the generic bundle version 1.0.
FMOD discusses the 2.04.00 Studio early-access release without specifying the architecture of its Mac executable.

limitation: A native build of the exact app is documented in a crash log, but the current official Mac release architecture could not be tied to a specific release version.

name: To MP3 Converter
product: To MP3 Converter 1 full Mac App Store edition by Amvidia

evidence.says: Amvidia says To MP3 Converter 1 is no longer supported or updated and tells existing Mac App Store purchasers to reinstall from their purchase history.
Apple’s public lookup for the exact scanned bundle ID returns no current listing.
Apple identifies the current To MP3 Converter 2 Mac App Store listing as com.amvidia.To-MP3-Converter-Free.

limitation: The final version and executable architecture of the original full Mac App Store bundle were not established.
notes: The separate vendor-download editions 1.0.22 and 2.0.3 both had universal main executables in inspection and both used com.amvidia.To-MP3-Converter-FS.

name: Growtopia
product: Growtopia standalone Mac game, originally by RTsoft and now published by Ubisoft

evidence.says: Ubisoft lists macOS as a Growtopia platform and announces a 2026-12-01 delisting from the Ubisoft Store.
Ubisoft’s launch announcement separately identifies Mac, Windows, iOS and Android versions.
Ubisoft’s Steam listing specifies Windows system requirements.

limitation: A current standalone Mac binary and its architecture could not be verified, and the historical standalone Mac download endpoint returned an error.
notes: The announced Ubisoft Store change was still in the future on the audit date.

name: Movavi Video Converter 22 Premium
product: Movavi Video Converter 22 Premium for Mac by Movavi Software Ltd.

evidence.says: Movavi’s lifecycle selector lists Video Converter for Mac major version 22 with an end-of-sales date of October 11, 2022 and end-of-support date of October 11, 2023.
The Mac changelog dates the last 22-series update, 22.5.0, to June 9, 2022 and separately documents the newer major release that added Mac ARM processor support.
The exact com.movavi.videoconverter22 scan reports an Intel executable for 22.4.0.

limitation: The architecture of the final 22.5.0 binary was not independently verified.
notes: Lifecycle dates were retrieved from the public JSON-RPC lifecycleInfo endpoint used by Movavi’s selector.

name: ARC 3 Analysis
product: ARC 3 Analysis standalone room measurement app from IK Multimedia ARC System 3

evidence.says: IK Multimedia’s ARC System 3 manual documents ARC 3 Analysis as its standalone measurement application, distinct from the correction plug-in.
IK Multimedia’s 2021 compatibility note lists ARC System 3.0.2 under products verified through Rosetta 2.
IK Multimedia introduced ARC 4 measurement and correction software as a new commercial release in February 2024.
IK Multimedia’s former ARC 3 product URL now redirects to the ARC X product.

limitation: The final standalone ARC 3 Analysis version, its architecture and its availability to existing license holders were not verified.
notes: The site scan verifies Intel architecture for 3.0.2 only, and later reports about ARC 3 plug-ins do not establish the standalone app architecture.

name: Norton 360
product: Norton 360 for Mac by Norton / Gen Digital

evidence.says: Norton’s release announcement dates Mac version 26.10.0 to 2026-10-28 and lists LiveUpdate and My Norton as distribution channels.
Norton confirms Apple Silicon compatibility for its recent device-security products and lists Norton 360 26.8.x or later for macOS 27.
Norton’s Mac installation instructions obtain the installer through the subscription account.

limitation: Norton confirms Apple Silicon compatibility, but the release announcement and support documentation do not identify the 26.10.0 main executable’s architecture.
notes: Community comments about universal builds did not provide version-linked executable evidence.

name: SteuerMac 2022
product: WISO Steuer-Mac 2022 direct-download edition by Buhl Data Service GmbH

evidence.says: Buhl still provides the WISO Steuer-Mac 2022 installer for the 2021 German tax year.
Buhl lists update 29.17 specifically for WISO Steuer-Mac 2022 and links its detailed release notes.
The publisher’s notes for the 29.17.5590 release describe data and tax-module updates without identifying the Mac executable architecture.
The cask points to Buhl’s 29.17.5590-RC1 artifact and identifies its app as SteuerMac 2022.app.

limitation: The direct-download 29.17.5590 executable architecture and Rosetta status are unverified, and its official image exceeds the 150 MB inspection limit.
notes: Apple’s same-year store edition uses a different bundle identifier. The 2022 edition is still receiving updates for tax year 2021.

name: Deezer
product: Deezer desktop music-streaming app by Deezer

evidence.says: Homebrew lists the official Deezer 8.0.10 Mac download under a darwin-x64 endpoint and does not state the executable architecture.
Deezer staff confirmed a single universal macOS installer in the 7.0.1 release discussion.
CoreCode lists Intel and Apple Silicon architecture for the exact Deezer bundle at version 7.0.20.
The official versioned endpoint returns a Deezer disk image of 207,843,085 bytes.

limitation: The earlier Mac releases have universal evidence, but the current 8.0.10 main executable architecture could not be verified within the download size limit.
notes: The x64 endpoint name is insufficient to identify the slices inside the current disk image.
